headline: **MLB Daily Recap: August 13, 2026**
article:
The Minnesota Twins secured a thrilling 7-5 victory over the Baltimore Orioles, while the St. Louis Cardinals dominated the Philadelphia Phillies 7-1. The Tampa Bay Rays took down the Athletics 8-4, and the Colorado Rockies secured a 6-4 win over the Arizona Diamondbacks.

Injuries and availability are impacting several teams. Pittsburgh Pirates catcher Endy Rodríguez has been placed on the 10-day injured list due to left hip inflammation, effective retroactive to August 10, 2026. Other notable injuries include Jake Bloss (Toronto Blue Jays), Riley Greene (Detroit Tigers), Kyle Karros (Colorado Rockies), José Suarez (Athletics), Blake Treinen (Los Angeles Dodgers), Isiah Kiner-Falefa (Boston Red Sox), and Kervin Castro (New York Yankees).

Several trades and roster movements have taken place. The Baltimore Orioles acquired center fielder Harold Rivas from the Boston Red Sox in a trade. The Miami Marlins traded RHP Lake Bachar to the Pittsburgh Pirates for RHP Brandan Bidois, LF Brian Sanchez, and IF Hyun Seung Lee. The Athletics acquired RHP Seth Johnson from the Philadelphia Phillies for RF Colby Thomas.

top_news.title: **Twins Take Down Orioles in Thrilling 7-5 Victory**
top_news.summary: The Minnesota Twins secured a 5-7 win over the Baltimore Orioles, handing the Orioles their loss. Dylan Beavers led the Orioles' offense with a home run and three RBIs.

top_news.title: **Cardinals Cruise Past Phillies 7-1**
top_news.summary: The St. Louis Cardinals dominated the Philadelphia Phillies, securing a 7-1 victory. Alec Burleson led the Phillies' offense with 2 hits, 3 RBIs, and 3 at-bats.

top_news.title: **Rays Take Down Athletics 8-4**
top_news.summary: The Tampa Bay Rays secured an 8-4 victory over the Athletics, with Liam Hicks leading the offense. Hicks finished with 3 hits, 1 home run, and 3 RBIs in 5 at-bats.

top_news.title: **Rockies Take Down Diamondbacks 6-4**
top_news.summary: The Colorado Rockies secured a 6-4 victory over the Arizona Diamondbacks, with Brett Sullivan leading the offense with a home run and three RBIs. Gerardo Carrillo impressed in relief, striking out four batters in two innings of work.

top_news.title: **Pirates Place Endy Rodríguez on 10-Day Injured List**
top_news.summary: Pittsburgh Pirates catcher Endy Rodríguez has been placed on the 10-day injured list due to left hip inflammation, effective retroactive to August 10, 2026.

top_news.title: **Rivas Traded to Orioles**
top_news.summary: The Baltimore Orioles acquired center fielder Harold Rivas from the Boston Red Sox in a trade. The deal is part of the larger trade involving Adley Rutschman, with a player to be named later still to be determined.
